cues: Stage four, the electron transport system, on the inner mitochondrial membrane, folded into cristae for extra area.
NADH hands its electrons to complex one.
They pass to ubiquinone, complex three, cytochrome c and complex four, and finally to oxygen, which takes up protons to form water.
Oxygen is the final electron acceptor.
text: Stage four, the electron transport system, on the inner mitochondrial membrane, folded into cristae for extra area. NADH hands its electrons to complex one. They pass to ubiquinone, complex three, cytochrome c and complex four, and finally to oxygen, which takes up protons to form water. Oxygen is the final electron acceptor.
